name.text: Completing a phrase for use of statistical methods

questiontext.text:
Choose the appropriate phrase that completes the sentence below.

Statistical methods are used to extract information from data. However ____________________

answer.text: the methods themselves are not the goal

feedback.text: Correct. So often, people get too caught up in the question of which methods to use and forget their actual goal. Never lose sight of what research questions you are trying to answer.

answer.text: only a statistician knows the correct method to use

feedback.text: Not quite - remember, so many people get caught up with the specifics of statistical methods, that they forget their research objectives.

answer.text: we must find a p-value to achieve that goal

feedback.text: Not quite - remember, so many people get caught up with the specifics of statistical methods, that they forget their research objectives.

answer.text: it is important to know every statistical method in order to make an informed choice

feedback.text: Not quite - remember, so many people get caught up with the specifics of statistical methods, that they forget their research objectives.
